LanguageData.AP_Enabled: Doctors give drugs on their own
LanguageData.AP_Enabled_Desc: Doctors (Doctor work) give colonists the drug that helps them, by how serious the problem is.
LanguageData.AP_Notify: Message when a drug is given
LanguageData.AP_Notify_Desc: A short message: who gave what to whom and why.
LanguageData.AP_UseMood_Desc: A colonist whose mood is below the break threshold gets a mood drug.
LanguageData.AP_UseRest_Desc: A colonist on the edge of exhaustion who is not sleeping gets a stimulant.
LanguageData.AP_PainFrom_Desc: From how much pain a painkiller is given. More pain = stronger drug.
LanguageData.AP_MinHours_Desc: For drugs without a lasting effect: how long to wait before giving the same drug again. Drugs with a lasting effect are not given while it lasts.
LanguageData.AP_AddictiveMode1: only when life is in danger
LanguageData.AP_AddictiveHelp: The drug is chosen by how serious it is: a mild, cheap drug for small troubles, the strongest for serious ones. A drug whose effect still lasts is not given again.
LanguageData.AP_ListHead: Drugs in the game and what they do ({0}). Untick those doctors should not use:
LanguageData.AP_AutoCare: Medical care level by how serious it is
LanguageData.AP_AutoCare_Desc: Bandages and medicine for tending: herbal for small injuries, industrial for illness and bigger injuries, the best when life is in danger. Colonists set to "no care" are left alone.
LanguageData.AP_CarePharmacist: Medical care level (bandages, tending medicine) is handled by Pharmacist.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOn: The mod sets itself up and works right away. Ideal for new players and anyone who does not want to tweak anything.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOffSame: Custom settings. Still the same as recommended.
LanguageData.MUI_ConfirmOn: Turn recommended settings on? Your changes ({0}) will be replaced with the recommended values.
LanguageData.MUI_Locked: Detailed settings are locked. Want to change them? Turn off the switch above – your values start from the recommended ones.
LanguageData.MUI_ChangedTip: Differs from the recommended setting ({0}). Click to restore the recommended value.
LanguageData.AP_CombatDrugs_Desc: A drafted colonist with enemies close takes one combat drug (Go-juice, Wake-up…) – from his inventory, or from a stack a few steps away when no enemy is near. Never with a chance of addiction, never twice within the set time, not for teetotalers, children or against their ideology. Can be switched off per colonist with a button.
LanguageData.AP_CombatHours: At most one dose per {0} h
LanguageData.AP_CombatHours_Desc: How long a colonist waits before taking another combat drug.
LanguageData.AP_CombatGizmo_Desc: On: this colonist takes a combat drug in a fight when it is safe (no chance of addiction).\nOff: this colonist never does.
LanguageData.AP_Rec1: Doctors give the right drug by how serious it is
LanguageData.AP_Rec2: Addictive drugs only when life is in danger
LanguageData.AP_Rec3: Fighters use combat drugs sensibly in a fight
LanguageData.AP_Rec4: Medical care level by the injuries
LanguageData.AP_UsePrevention_Desc: Drugs that protect against illness (penoxycyline and the like) are given regularly, a little before the last dose runs out.
LanguageData.AP_UseChronic_Desc: For a bad back, cataract, frailty or old wounds: a drug that helps moving, hands or sight.
LanguageData.AP_Plan_Desc: Click to change. No: a doctor gives contraception regularly. Wanted: a fertility drug when there is one. Adults (18+) only, never during pregnancy.
